messages:
carla: Kicking off the timezone-staggered cutover for v2.3.1. Plan = US -> EU -> APAC, canary sizes + ramp: US 10% -> 50% -> 100%, EU 25% -> 100%, APAC paused until warm pool confirmed. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Pin fallback=2.3.0 for slice rollbacks. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2.3.1 (contains known perf deltas). Need APAC warm pool + KV cache priming. cc @ben @dmitri @ellen

deploy-bot: preflight checks (dbf-20260321-01): infra=OK, warm_pools: US=ready, EU=ready, APAC=insufficient_quota(+2 GPUs requested). autoscaler policy applied. checksums ok.

ben: noted re: APAC quota. @sre-oncall can you approve +2 GPUs for APAC warm pool for the window? rough cost ~= $120/hr.

sre-oncall: approved +2 GPUs for APAC for 3h (provision id: prov-912). I'll watch thermal/eviction. throttle ceiling set to 75% util for rollout.

dmitri: telemetry baseline: p99 lat US=220ms EU=240ms APAC=260ms (seq512). Expect +~10% on v2.3.1. Recommend APAC canary start at 5-8% not 10%.

carla: manifest update: model_version=2.3.1; fallback_version=2.3.0; rollout_slices=[us:10,eu:25,apac:5]; canary_duration=20m. Manifest pushed: https://internal.redwood/deploys/dbf-20260321-01/manifest

ellen: EU compliance check: enable audit_log_retention and set kms_key_id=key-uk-01 for EU slice before final ramp. If not set, hold EU.

alice: I'll take the US canary in +1hr and run smoke + eval harness (urls in my checklist).

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout initiated by carla. starting canary sequence: US -> EU -> APAC (APAC will only proceed if warm_pool confirmed). logs: https://internal.redwood/logs/dbf-20260321-01

alice: US canary smoke: all green. sample prompts pass, cost delta within 5% baseline. :thumbsup:

dmitri: APAC canary started (slice 5%). Observed small latency blip at +4m: p95 -> 420ms, worker-12 CPU 90%. autoscaler triggered at +6m.

sre-oncall: spun up additional replica in APAC pool. thermal on host-pool increased; watching. If p95 > 450ms for 5m, we'll enact slice revert.

carla: decision: pause APAC rollout and revert APAC slice to fallback 2.3.0. US and EU continue. Commanded revert and kept traffic on 2.3.0 for APAC.

carla: (command for audit) `deployctl rollback --slice apac --to 2.3.0 --reason "latency spike"`

deploy-bot: action: APAC slice reverted to 2.3.0, canary aborted. logs: https://internal.redwood/logs/dbf-20260321-01/apac-revert. notification sent to #ops. final_slice_status: apac=reverted

ben: good call. Filing follow-ups: INFR-3412 (APAC KV cache eviction/priming), RUNTIME-724 (quantization fallback probe). tagging @eng-runtime @eng-ml

ellen: EU note: I confirmed kms_key_id present and audit retention enabled. EU final ramp allowed once EU slice passes 15m of stability.

alice: ramped US->EU to 50% now. Observability: no error upticks, token cost within expected band.

sre-oncall: will deprovision the +2 GPUs at T+2h unless APAC needs re-open. leaving a buffer until we close the run.

carla: follow-ups for release notes and comms: 1) mark APAC segment as 'deferred' in notes, 2) add slice-only rollback example to runbook, 3) escalate to eng-runtime to validate cache priming strategy. I'll post update to #release-updates once notes edited.

deploy-bot: rollout finished (partial_success). slices updated: US=2.3.1, EU=2.3.1 (in ramp), APAC=2.3.0 (reverted). uid=dbf-20260321-01 final_status=partial_success

alice: thanks team. LGTM on the partial rollout. :party_parrot:

ben: quick ops note: consider cost-hedge for future APAC warm pools (autoscale budget alerting). I'll draft a short runbook rule. :memo:

carla: recorded. closing thread for active coordination; will reopen if APAC re-test scheduled.
